description: This file implements a mail splitting utility that processes mailbox files and splits them into individual message files. The code includes functions for parsing mailbox message boundaries, handling maildir directories, and command-line argument processing for the 'git mailsplit' command.

methods.name: int is_from_line(const char * line,int len)
methods.description: Checks if a given line in a mailbox starts with 'From ' and contains a valid timestamp and date format.

methods.name: int is_gtfrom(const struct strbuf * buf)
methods.description: Detects if a given strbuf contains a '>From ' line, indicating a message boundary in email with '>

methods.name: int split_one(FILE * mbox,const char * name,int allow_bare)
methods.description: Splits a mailbox message starting from the buffer, writing it to a specified file. Handles 'From ' lines and mailbox formatting.

methods.name: int populate_maildir_list(struct string_list * list,const char * path)
methods.description: Populates a list with filenames from the 'cur' and 'new' subdirectories within a maildir, filtering out hidden files.

methods.name: int maildir_filename_cmp(const char * a,const char * b)
methods.description: Compares two maildir filenames numerically where possible for sorting purposes.

methods.name: int split_maildir(const char * maildir,const char * dir,int nr_prec,int skip)
methods.description: Splits messages from a maildir directory into individual files based on message boundaries.

methods.name: int split_mbox(const char * file,const char * dir,int allow_bare,int nr_prec,int skip)
methods.description: Splits an mbox file into individual message files, handling the parsing and boundary detection.

methods.name: int cmd_mailsplit(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command-line handler that processes arguments and orchestrates the splitting of mailbox files.

ctags.name: cmd_mailsplit
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: split_maildir
ctags.signature: (const char * maildir,const char * dir,int nr_prec,int skip)

ctags.name: split_mbox
ctags.pattern: /^static int split_mbox(const char *file, const char *dir, int allow_bare,$/
ctags.signature: (const char * file,const char * dir,int allow_bare,int nr_prec,int skip)

ctags.name: split_one
ctags.pattern: /^static int split_one(FILE *mbox, const char *name, int allow_bare)$/
